party_a.evidence_quote: HSBC Bank USA, National Association (“Party A”)

party_b.evidence_quote: Volkswagen Auto Loan Enhanced Trust 2007-1 (“Party B”)

governing_law.evidence_quote: (ISDA Agreements Subject to New York Law Only)

threshold.value: Infinity for Party A (subject to being reduced to zero upon certain rating downgrade triggers); Not Applicable for Party B.
threshold.evidence_quote: “Threshold” means with respect to Party A: Infinity

minimum_transfer_amount.value: $100,000 when the Notional Amount is greater than $50 million, or otherwise $50,000 (applies to both Party A and Party B).
minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote: “Minimum Transfer Amount” means with respect to Party A: (i) $100,000 when the Notional Amount is greater than $50 million, or (ii) otherwise, $50,000.

rounding.value: Delivery Amount rounded up and Return Amount rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of $10,000.00.
rounding.evidence_quote: The Delivery Amount will be rounded up and the Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of $10,000.00, respectively.

valuation_percentage.value: Equal to the percentage specified under the applicable Rating Agency's column, or the lowest of the applicable percentages if rated by more than one Rating Agency.
valuation_percentage.evidence_quote: The Valuation Percentage shall equal the percentage specified under such Rating Agency’s name above. If Party A is rated by more than one Rating Agency specified above, the Valuation Percentage shall equal the lowest of the applicable percentages specified above.
